al_hospital_boulders.blurb: Hospital Boulders is a sandstone boulder field on the west brow of Lookout Mountain, just north of Gadsden in northeast Alabama, with wide views from the top of the ridge. Nearly everything here is bouldering, with only a few short trad, sport and top-rope lines on the same brow. Problems run from easy warm-ups to a handful of very hard test pieces, but the heart of the area is V2 to V4, so moderate climbers will find plenty to do. Expect face lines, stemming grooves and mantles. The boulders sit a short, easy hike in and fall into four groups: Barn Area, Eddie Area, Lower Area and Water Tower Area. There is still room for new problems.

ny_central_park.blurb: Central Park holds Manhattan's best-known urban bouldering, on outcrops of Manhattan schist scattered through the park. Every climb is a short, rope-free problem. Rat Rock, near the park's southwest corner by the ballfields, is the social hub and the biggest single cluster; others are spread around, including Worthless Boulder toward the north end, Westside Outcrops, Cat Rock and Split Rock. The grades start easy, with a strong showing at V0 to V2, and stretch up to a thin handful of very hard problems past V10. Most blocks are small, so this suits quick sessions, after-work meetups and learning the basics in the middle of the city rather than a long day out.

mo_em_robinson_bluff.blurb: Robinson Bluff is a long dolomite bluff beside the Big River, near the small community of Tiff in Washington County, Missouri, south of St. Louis. It is mainly a sport-climbing area, with a smaller set of boulder problems and almost no trad. The rock gives mostly moderate face climbing, with some overhanging sections and crack lines, and many routes are single pitch. A few of the taller routes top 100 feet, and some towers allow multi-pitch climbing, which is unusual in Missouri. Grades run from about 5.5 to 5.12, peaking at 5.10, so there is plenty for newer leaders and a good number of harder lines. The bluff is split into a north side and a south side.

oh_wayne_national_forest_marietta_unit.blurb: The Marietta Unit of Wayne National Forest lies in southeast Ohio, just north of Marietta, and is a scattered set of sandstone boulder areas. All of the climbing is bouldering. Problems gather in small sectors such as Upper Archers Fork, Sheets Run Road, Irish Run and Bell Ridge, each tucked into its own corner of the forest, so a day usually means choosing one or two. The sandstone varies from very good to poor and is on the porous side, so it can take a day or two to dry after heavy rain. Grades start easy, with most problems between V1 and V4 and a modest number at V5 and above. Many lines are still unclimbed, and there is no cell service, so save maps ahead of time.

ny_b_chapel_pond_pass.blurb: Chapel Pond Pass sits in the heart of the Keene Valley region of the Adirondacks, with roughly thirty crags and walls strung along the road corridor. Trad climbing dominates, on anorthosite, a rare rock that locals simply call granite, with some sport, a little top-roping and a few boulders. Beer Walls and Spider's Web are the busiest crags, offering cracks, corners and arêtes on steep walls, and Spanky's Area, Upper Washbowl Cliff and Chapel Pond Slab add more. Grades run from 5.3 to 5.13, with the bulk between 5.8 and 5.11 and a few harder lines, so there is something for most trad climbers, including longer moderate routes.

ut_ibex.blurb: Ibex is a remote quartzite area in Utah's West Desert, in the Tule Valley of the Confusion Range, west of Delta and beside a dry lakebed. The quartzite is very hard and durable, so climbing after rain is usually not a problem. Bouldering is the largest part of the climbing, with sport and trad nearly as common. Problems run from V0 to V11 with many in the lower and middle grades, while roped climbs mostly fall between 5.9 and 5.12. The cooler months, roughly November through April, bring the best friction. It is quiet and open, with no services nearby, and the climbing is spread across many buttresses and boulder groups, including Red Monster Area, Corral Crags, Newlywed Area and South Corridor.
